ItemId.description: Optional unique identifier of the campaign. When it matches a stored campaign, that campaign is updated. Otherwise a new campaign is created under this identifier, so references to it from other entries and steps keep resolving.

CampaignGroupId.description: Identifier of the campaign group this campaign is reported under.

InteractionType.description: Whether the campaign is handled manually by an agent or automated by AI.

Channel.description: Communication channel used by the campaign, for example 'SMS', 'Chat', or 'Email'.

InitialOutboundPromptPattern.description: For automated campaigns, the initial message used to start the conversation with the customer.

CampaignGoal.description: Description of what success looks like, used by the AI to decide when the conversation can end.

ProviderName.description: Name of the AI provider used for automation.

ConnectionName.description: Name of the provider connection used for automation.

DeploymentName.description: Name of the model deployment used for automation.

SystemMessage.description: System message that steers the automated conversation.

Temperature.description: Sampling temperature applied to the automated completions.

TopP.description: Nucleus sampling probability applied to the automated completions.

FrequencyPenalty.description: Frequency penalty applied to the automated completions.

PresencePenalty.description: Presence penalty applied to the automated completions.

MaxTokens.description: Maximum number of tokens the automated completions may generate.

ToolNames.description: Names of the tools the automation is allowed to invoke.

AllowAIToUpdateContact.description: Whether the AI is allowed to update the contact during an automated conversation.

AllowAIToUpdateSubject.description: Whether the AI is allowed to update the subject during an automated conversation.

Properties.description: Extension data other features attach to the campaign, keyed by the name of the settings object (for example channel-specific routing settings). When present, it replaces the stored extension data as a whole.
